title: Throwable TNT
description: A Minecraft Datapack That Adds A Throwable Tnt That Explodes On Impact When An Entity Or Block Is Hit
body:
To Get The Item Write 
```
/function tnt:give
```
The Item Will Appear As A Snowball But If The Texturepack Is Installed, The Tnt Will Have A Custom Texture. Download it at **https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/throwable-tnt-texturepack**

If You Wanna Make Your Own Texture Pack, The Custom Data Is {throwable_tnt:1b} And Custom Model Data Is 12345 (Or Just Edit The Texture Pack I Guess)
